item.title: British boy, 13, stabbed to death in Portugal before suspected attacker killed in house explosion
item.description: A 13-year-old British boy has been killed after being stabbed in the Portuguese town of Tomar on Tuesday.His mother’s former partner is suspected of carrying out the attack and later dying in a gas explosion.Portuguese authorities report that the 43-year-old suspect, a Portuguese national, allegedly killed the teenager with a bladed weapon before barricading himself inside the property.The man is believed to have deliberately turned on the gas supply, triggering a blast that claimed his life.
